findings.text: The company has the status 'active' and was incorporated on 22 June 2004.
No insolvency record is held for the company.

There are 0 outstanding charges, 0 part-satisfied charges, and 3 satisfied charges registered.
The current directors are linked to 50 other companies, 44 of which are active and 6 dissolved.

headline.text: ACME is an active company incorporated in 2004 with up-to-date filings, though its directors are linked to many other companies and recent officer changes have occurred.
